lead.title: Generations of home cooking, now serving Frisco
paragraphs: Chaska serves desi food with a Punjabi tadka, cooked from family recipes that were passed down by hand rather than written down. Authentic home flavors, made the way maa used to make them, alongside a few Indo-fusion dishes of our own.
Everything is served family style, meant for the middle of the table.

figure.caption: Masala idli, crisp outside and soft inside, with fresh coconut chutney.

dishes.description: Slow roasted in desi ghee and loaded with badam and pista, made the way maa used to make it.
Yogurt and besan kadhi with soft pakoras, tempered with dried red chilies and cumin.
Street food, plated like fine dining. Paneer rolled in flaky parantha with green chutney and pomegranate.

family.title: Recipes taught by hand, kept by memory
paragraphs: Owner Ronika Singh Bhatia learned this food in her family’s kitchen, where recipes were measured in handfuls and pinches and passed from one generation to the next. Chaska is her way of bringing that table to Frisco.
The family is all here, including Snoopy, the house shih tzu and honorary sous chef.

figure.caption: Street style sprouted moong dal salad with peanuts, tomato, pomegranate and chaat masala.

catering.title: Fresh, homemade trays from our kitchen to your table
catering.body: Catering trays and high tea spreads for your gatherings, made to order. Message us on Instagram to plan yours.
